doc: Earth-equivalent |latitude| (degrees) per row: min(|degrees(lat)| / hadley_deg * 30, 65) where 65 = EARTH_CAP_DEG - ZONE_DEG / 2 (past it the zones of Earth's ice-contaminated caps are replaced by the 62.5..67.5 zone). A body whose Hadley edge is at 15 degrees: zones stretch twice as fast, the cap starts at 32.5 degrees. Rows: a 64-row grid then the poles, the equator, +-0.0, 1e-9, 0.5, 1.2, 1.5 rad. Float64 closed form: 1e-9.
